hero.title: The tool that keeps the plan up to date for you.
hero.subtitle: Ajour is an open source project tool for small projects with 2 to 10 people. You describe the project in plain words, the AI proposes the plan, writes the week's status and suggests changes when reality moves. You decide.
hero.trust: Open source · AGPL-3.0 · Data in the EU · Part of Haij

flows.week: The week: status in one minute
flows.drift: Drift: a replan you say yes to

values.aiTitle: The AI maintains, the human decides
values.aiBody: The AI gathers what happened, drafts and proposes changes to the plan. It never sends anything out, never deletes anything and commits nobody to anything without your yes. Everything can be undone.
values.dataBody: Everything a workspace owns can be taken out with one click in open formats and deleted again completely. Hosted with EU-owned providers, or in your own environment with a local language model.
values.securityBody: Passkeys and two-step login from the start, workspaces separated all the way down in the database, and every change in a log that cannot be edited.

landing.status: Version 1 is being built on the Haij foundation. Access by application.

family.body: Ajour is part of Haij, a family of open source tools with shared principles on real open source, self-hosting and your data.

about.title: About Ajour
about.subtitle: Which release of Ajour is running here, and whether the database has kept up.
about.dirtyHint: Built from a working tree with uncommitted changes, so the commit does not tell the whole truth about the code that is running.
about.releaseHint: The version number is raised by hand when a step is worth naming. The commit is stamped in at build time and points at exactly the code answering here.
about.schemaHint: The number of migrations the build was made from, against the number the database has applied.
about.schemaBehindHint: The database has fewer migrations than the code expects. Run the migrations before using the system further.
about.license: Ajour is open source under AGPL-3.0 and part of the Haij family.
